review: en, sl, it, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

description.en: Shepherd Jack has had sheep stolen and walls damaged, and he knows how the law works in the dale: the crime and the witness, the police station, the suspect who is arrested, the court in Carlisle, a fine or prison.
description.sl: Pastirju Jacku so ukradli ovce in poškodovali zidove, zato ve, kako deluje zakon v dolini: kaznivo dejanje in priča, policijska postaja, osumljenec, ki ga aretirajo, sodišče v Carlislu, globa ali zapor.
description.it: Al pastore Jack hanno rubato pecore e danneggiato muri, e sa come funziona la legge nella valle: il reato e il testimone, la stazione di polizia, il sospettato arrestato, il tribunale di Carlisle, una multa o il carcere.
description.de: Schäfer Jack wurden Schafe gestohlen und Mauern beschädigt, und er weiß, wie das Recht im Tal funktioniert: die Straftat und der Zeuge, die Polizeiwache, der verhaftete Verdächtige, das Gericht in Carlisle, eine Geldstrafe oder Gefängnis.

words.example_en: There is very little crime in the dale, apart from the odd stolen bike.
words.example_sl: V dolini je zelo malo kaznivih dejanj, razen kakšnega ukradenega kolesa.
words.example_it: Nella valle ci sono pochissimi reati, a parte qualche bici rubata.
words.example_de: Im Tal gibt es kaum Straftaten, abgesehen von einem gestohlenen Fahrrad hin und wieder.
words.note: Crime is also uncountable: crime in the city. A criminal commits a crime.
words.note_sl: Crime je tudi neštevno: crime in the city. A criminal commits a crime.
words.note_it: Crime è anche non numerabile: crime in the city. A criminal commits a crime.
words.note_de: Crime ist auch unzählbar: crime in the city. A criminal commits a crime.

words.example_en: The theft of forty sheep was reported to the police.
words.example_sl: Tatvino štiridesetih ovac so prijavili policiji.
words.example_it: Il furto di quaranta pecore è stato denunciato alla polizia.
words.example_de: Der Diebstahl von vierzig Schafen wurde der Polizei gemeldet.

words.example_en: There were two burglaries in the holiday cottages last winter.
words.example_sl: Lani pozimi sta bila v počitniških hišah dva vloma.
words.example_it: L'inverno scorso ci sono stati due furti con scasso nelle case vacanze.
words.example_de: Letzten Winter gab es zwei Einbrüche in den Ferienhäusern.

words.example_en: Someone stole the lead from the church roof.
words.example_sl: Nekdo je s cerkvene strehe ukradel svinec.
words.example_it: Qualcuno ha rubato il piombo dal tetto della chiesa.
words.example_de: Jemand hat das Blei vom Kirchendach gestohlen.
words.note: Steal, stole, stolen. You steal a thing; you rob a person or a place.
words.note_sl: Steal, stole, stolen. Steal a thing (stvar); rob a person or a place (osebo ali kraj).
words.note_it: Steal, stole, stolen. Steal a thing (una cosa); rob a person or a place (una persona o un posto).
words.note_de: Steal, stole, stolen. Steal a thing (eine Sache); rob a person or a place (jemanden, einen Ort).

words.example_en: The post office in Penrith was robbed in broad daylight.
words.example_sl: Pošto v Penrithu so oropali sredi belega dne.
words.example_it: L'ufficio postale di Penrith è stato rapinato in pieno giorno.
words.example_de: Die Post in Penrith wurde am helllichten Tag ausgeraubt.

words.example_en: A witness saw a white van near the field at midnight.
words.example_sl: Priča je opolnoči blizu polja videla bel kombi.
words.example_it: Un testimone ha visto un furgone bianco vicino al campo a mezzanotte.
words.example_de: Ein Zeuge sah um Mitternacht einen weißen Lieferwagen beim Feld.

words.example_en: The case will go to court in Carlisle next month.
words.example_sl: Primer bo prihodnji mesec prišel pred sodišče v Carlislu.
words.example_it: Il caso andrà in tribunale a Carlisle il mese prossimo.
words.example_de: Der Fall kommt nächsten Monat in Carlisle vor Gericht.

words.example_en: You should speak to a lawyer before you sign anything.
words.example_sl: Preden kaj podpišeš, se posvetuj s pravnikom.
words.example_it: Prima di firmare qualcosa dovresti parlare con un avvocato.
words.example_de: Bevor du etwas unterschreibst, solltest du mit einem Rechtsanwalt sprechen.
words.note: In Britain a solicitor gives advice and does the papers; a barrister speaks in the higher courts.
words.note_sl: V Britaniji solicitor svetuje in ureja papirje; barrister zastopa na višjih sodiščih.
words.note_it: In Gran Bretagna il solicitor consiglia e prepara le carte; il barrister parla nei tribunali superiori.
words.note_de: In Großbritannien berät der solicitor und macht die Papiere; der barrister plädiert vor höheren Gerichten.

words.example_en: He got a fine of two hundred pounds for parking on the verge.
words.example_sl: Za parkiranje na robu ceste je dobil denarno kazen dvesto funtov.
words.example_it: Ha preso una multa di duecento sterline per aver parcheggiato sul bordo della strada.
words.example_de: Er hat zweihundert Pfund Geldstrafe bekommen, weil er am Straßenrand geparkt hat.
words.note: Fine also means well or good: I'm fine.
words.note_sl: Fine pomeni tudi dobro: I'm fine.
words.note_it: Fine vuol dire anche bene: I'm fine.
words.note_de: Fine heißt auch gut: I'm fine.

words.example_en: Two men were arrested near the M6 with the stolen quad bikes.
words.example_sl: Na avtocesti M6 so aretirali dva moška z ukradenima štirikolesnikoma.
words.example_it: Due uomini sono stati arrestati vicino alla M6 con i quad rubati.
words.example_de: Zwei Männer wurden an der M6 mit den gestohlenen Quads verhaftet.

words.example_en: The police have a suspect, but no proof yet.
words.example_sl: Policija ima osumljenca, a še nobenega dokaza.
words.example_it: La polizia ha un sospettato, ma ancora nessuna prova.
words.example_de: Die Polizei hat einen Verdächtigen, aber noch keinen Beweis.
words.note: The noun is SUS-pect; the verb to suspect is sus-PECT.
words.note_sl: Samostalnik je SUS-pect; glagol to suspect je sus-PECT.
words.note_it: Il nome è SUS-pect; il verbo to suspect è sus-PECT.
words.note_de: Das Nomen ist SUS-pect; das Verb to suspect sus-PECT.

words.example_en: He says he is innocent and was at home all night.
words.example_sl: Pravi, da je nedolžen in je bil vso noč doma.
words.example_it: Dice di essere innocente e di essere stato a casa tutta la notte.
words.example_de: Er sagt, er sei unschuldig und die ganze Nacht zu Hause gewesen.

words.example_en: The jury found him guilty of theft.
words.example_sl: Porota ga je spoznala za krivega tatvine.
words.example_it: La giuria lo ha dichiarato colpevole di furto.
words.example_de: Die Geschworenen sprachen ihn des Diebstahls schuldig.
words.note: Guilty is also a feeling: I feel guilty about eating all the cake.
words.note_sl: Guilty je tudi občutek: I feel guilty about eating all the cake (slabo vest imam).
words.note_it: Guilty è anche un sentimento: I feel guilty about eating all the cake (mi sento in colpa).
words.note_de: Guilty ist auch ein Gefühl: I feel guilty about eating all the cake (schlechtes Gewissen).

words.example_en: If he is found guilty, he could go to prison.
words.example_sl: Če ga spoznajo za krivega, lahko gre v zapor.
words.example_it: Se viene giudicato colpevole, potrebbe finire in carcere.
words.example_de: Wenn er schuldig gesprochen wird, könnte er ins Gefängnis kommen.

words.example_en: It's against the law to let your dog chase sheep.
words.example_sl: Po zakonu je prepovedano, da tvoj pes preganja ovce.
words.example_it: È contro la legge lasciare che il cane insegua le pecore.
words.example_de: Es ist gesetzlich verboten, seinen Hund Schafe jagen zu lassen.

words.example_en: It's illegal to camp anywhere you like in England.
words.example_sl: V Angliji je nezakonito kampirati, kjer koli hočeš.
words.example_it: In Inghilterra è illegale campeggiare dove si vuole.
words.example_de: In England ist es illegal, irgendwo zu zelten, wo man will.
words.note: Wild camping is allowed on Dartmoor, not in the Lakes, unless the landowner says yes.
words.note_sl: Kampiranje v naravi je dovoljeno na Dartmooru, na jezerih pa le z dovoljenjem lastnika.
words.note_it: Il campeggio libero è permesso a Dartmoor, non ai Laghi, salvo permesso del proprietario.
words.note_de: Wildcampen ist in Dartmoor erlaubt, in den Lakes nur mit Erlaubnis des Grundbesitzers.

words.example_en: The victims of the burglary got most of their things back.
words.example_sl: Žrtve vloma so dobile večino stvari nazaj.
words.example_it: Le vittime del furto hanno riavuto quasi tutte le loro cose.
words.example_de: Die Opfer des Einbruchs haben das meiste zurückbekommen.

words.example_en: The sign says "Private: do not trespass".
words.example_sl: Na tabli piše: »Zasebno: vstop prepovedan«.
words.example_it: Il cartello dice: «Proprietà privata: vietato l'accesso».
words.example_de: Auf dem Schild steht: »Privat: Betreten verboten«.

words.example_en: The storm caused a lot of damage to the roofs.
words.example_sl: Nevihta je na strehah povzročila veliko škode.
words.example_it: La tempesta ha causato molti danni ai tetti.
words.example_de: Der Sturm hat an den Dächern viel Schaden angerichtet.
words.note: Damage is uncountable: a lot of damage. Damages (plural) is money a court orders.
words.note_sl: Damage je neštevno: a lot of damage. Damages (množina) je odškodnina.
words.note_it: Damage non si conta: a lot of damage. Damages (plurale) è il risarcimento.
words.note_de: Damage ist unzählbar: a lot of damage. Damages (Plural) ist Schadenersatz.

words.example_en: The police are investigating the fire at the old barn.
words.example_sl: Policija preiskuje požar v starem skednju.
words.example_it: La polizia sta indagando sull'incendio del vecchio fienile.
words.example_de: Die Polizei ermittelt wegen des Brandes in der alten Scheune.

words.example_en: She accused her neighbour of moving the boundary wall.
words.example_sl: Soseda je obtožila, da je premaknil mejni zid.
words.example_it: Ha accusato il vicino di aver spostato il muro di confine.
words.example_de: Sie beschuldigte ihren Nachbarn, die Grenzmauer versetzt zu haben.

words.example_en: The nearest police station is in Keswick, but it's only open on weekdays.
words.example_sl: Najbližja policijska postaja je v Keswicku, a je odprta le med tednom.
words.example_it: La stazione di polizia più vicina è a Keswick, ma è aperta solo nei giorni feriali.
words.example_de: Die nächste Polizeiwache ist in Keswick, aber sie ist nur werktags offen.

words.example_en: The bus shelter was damaged by vandalism again.
words.example_sl: Avtobusna nadstrešnica je bila spet poškodovana zaradi vandalizma.
words.example_it: La pensilina dell'autobus è stata di nuovo danneggiata dai vandali.
words.example_de: Das Wartehäuschen wurde schon wieder durch Vandalismus beschädigt.

words.example_en: Most crimes in the countryside are committed at night.
words.example_sl: Večina kaznivih dejanj na podeželju je zagrešena ponoči.
words.example_it: La maggior parte dei reati in campagna viene commessa di notte.
words.example_de: Die meisten Straftaten auf dem Land werden nachts begangen.
